integrity: Full proof and runnable algebraic, quadrature, and nonnormal-matrix diagnostics embedded; finite diagnostics are not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Equal-length consecutive stages on autonomous linear equations; jointly uniform marginals; samplewise scalar unconditional stability, finite-dimensional matrix dissipativity; no claim for nonlinear or iid-stage schemes. Original method uses independent stage sampling, unlike the coupled construction. Mathematical originality is best-knowledge and lacks independent validation.
title: Antithetic coupling rigidity and logarithmic stiff damping for randomized implicit stages
